paper_metadata.title: InternVL: Scaling up Vision Foundation Models and Aligning for Generic Visual-Linguistic Tasks
paper_metadata.abstract: The exponential growth of large language models (LLMs) has opened up numerous possibilities for multimodal AGI systems. However, the progress in vision and vision-language foundation models, which are also critical elements of multi-modal AGI, has not kept pace with LLMs. In this work, we design a large-scale vision-language foundation model (InternVL), which scales up the vision foundation model to 6 billion parameters and progressively aligns it with the LLM, using web-scale image-text data from various sources. This model can be broadly applied to and achieve state-of-the-art performance on 32 generic visual-linguistic benchmarks including visual perception tasks such as image-level or pixel-level recognition, vision-language tasks such as zero-shot image/video classification, zero-shot image/video-text retrieval, and link with LLMs to create multi-modal dialogue systems. It has powerful visual capabilities and can be a good alternative to the ViT-22B. We hope that our research could contribute to the development of multi-modal large models. Code and models are available at https://github.com/OpenGVLab/InternVL.

extraction_data.innovation: Parameter-balanced vision-language architecture: scales vision encoder to 6B parameters and aligns it with an 8B-parameter LLM middleware that acts as a 'glue' layer to reorganize visual features based on user commands; differs from prior vision-only or dual-tower designs by harmonizing representation scales. Progressive image-text alignment strategy: maximizes utilization of web-scale noisy image-text data for contrastive learning while reserving fine-grained, high-quality data for generative learning; ensures consistent representation enhancement and addresses heterogeneity/quality variations in web data.

extraction_data.finetuning_data: High-quality instruction data, non-dialogue datasets converted to instruction format, ~4M high-quality instruction samples, LLaVA-Instruct-158K, LLaVA-Caption-558K, LLaVA-Detail-23K, LLaVA-CC3M-Pretrain-595K, LLaVA-Wild-178K, LLaVA-Pretrain-595K, VQAv2, OKVQA, A-OKVQA, IconQA, AI2D, GQA, RefCOCO/+/g, Toloka, LLaVA-150K, SVIT, VisDial, LRV-Instruction, LLaVA-Mix-665K
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: Patch-based visual encoder (ViT-style), Standard multi-head self-attention (LLaMA backbone); vision via attention pooling, Multi-head self-attention (LLM backbone)
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Stage 1: Image-text alignment with mild filtering (4.98B data); Stage 2: Generative supervision with stringent filtering (1.03B data); Stage 3: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT)

extraction_data.innovation: Vision-language alignment using QLLaMA as a language middleware; exhibits stronger robustness to distribution shift across ImageNet variants; state-of-the-art zero-shot image-text retrieval.

extraction_data.application: Zero-shot image classification, visual reasoning, visual knowledge acquisition, visual commonsense, object hallucination
